case_name: Davao City Mining Ban and Panigan-Tamugan Watershed Dispute
docket_no: SP Resolution / May 2015 Mining Ban Ordinance
title: THE DAVAO CITY WATERSHED PROTECTION AND MINING BAN ORDINANCE
enacting_clause: BE IT ORDAINED BY THE SANGGUNIANG PANLUNGSOD OF DAVAO CITY, IN SESSION ASSEMBLED, THAT:

sections.text: This Ordinance shall be known as the 'Davao City Watershed Protection and Mining Ban Ordinance'.

No mining operations of any nature, whether large-scale or small-scale, shall be permitted anywhere within the territorial jurisdiction of Davao City. The City Mayor shall refuse to issue business permits or Mayor's clearances to any entity holding national mineral agreements (MPSAs) from the national government.
The Panigan-Tamugan recharge basin is declared an environmentally critical zone closed to all industrial extraction, quarrying, and mineral exploration activities.
Violators shall be penalized with a fine of Five Thousand Pesos (P5,000.00) or imprisonment for one (1) year, or both, plus revocation of municipal permits.
This Ordinance shall take effect immediately upon enactment and publication.
